name: scope-path-with-a-space
description: A source path segment holding a space is percent-encoded in the reference, because no reference holds whitespace outside a quoted component: the unexported function nothing calls in src/my file.ts is reported, and its finding's reference spells the segment my%20file.ts. The suppression phase writes that reference into an ignore entry beside the decoded path src/my file.ts, and the entry binds the finding.
